DTR · TALK ABOUT A SCENE

Dear Monterrey, Show Your Work

STS-HS9-L4-13001400-HSALG1-PPX-LAT-02 • HS Algebra I Grade 9 • Solving Quadratic Equations
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
Every Friday this class writes to their pen pals at a secondary school in Monterrey, and every letter carries a quadratic puzzle inside it. The rule of the exchange is strict. Whoever opens a letter must solve the puzzle by a different route than the sender used, then mail the work back so both classes can compare. After a semester of letters, the two classes proved something worth writing down: factoring, completing the square, and the quadratic formula always land on the same two answers.
Monterrey just mailed back the equation x squared minus 4x minus 12 equals 0. Which two numbers multiply to negative 12 and add to negative 4?
Optional. You do not have to record this one.
1
What is Camila doing?
Look at the picture. Justify what Camila is doing with exact evidence. Use precise words, not "stuff."
2
What is Rafael holding?
Look at the picture. Justify what Rafael holds and how the exchange uses it. Name the item exactly.
3
What is the teacher doing?
Look at the picture. Justify what the teacher is doing and why it completes the exchange. Use exact details.
4
What room is this? How do you know?
Look at the picture. Justify what kind of classroom this is with at least two exact clues.
5
Tell me about the letter wall.
Look at the picture. Justify how the letter wall organizes the notes and the problems. Use exact terms.
6
What is Valentina wearing?
Look at the picture. Justify Valentina's role from her clothing and what she carries. Be precise.
Record an answer for each question, then submit.
